svg.text: G major up the low E string · C major R·3·7 + R·7·3 up the A string — every chord is the same compact three-note climb
G MAJOR · UP THE LOW E STRING — 1·7·3 SHELLS
roots on the low E string: G·A·B·C·D·E·F♯ at frets 3 · 5 · 7 · 8 · 10 · 12 · 14
root on the 6th string · 6th · 7th · 8th all on the D string (6th is the 7th of the chord one step below) · 3rd on the G string
ghosts 5 · 6 · 8 ring the 7th — 6–7–8 climb the D string as the shell moves up
C MAJOR · UP THE A STRING — 1·3·7 SHELLS
roots on the A string: C·D·E·F·G·A·B at frets 3 · 5 · 7 · 8 · 10 · 12 · 14
root on the 5th string · 3rd on the D string · 7th on the G string — compact R·3·7 shells
ghosts 5 · 6 · 8 ring the 7th — 6–7–8 climb the G string as the shell moves up (kept)
C MAJOR · UP THE A STRING — 1·7·3 SHELLS
roots on the A string: C·D·E·F·G·A·B at frets 3 · 5 · 7 · 8 · 10 · 12 · 14
root on the 5th string · 6th · 7th · 8th all on the G string (6th is the 7th of the chord one step below) · 3rd on the B string
ghosts 5 · 6 · 8 ring the 7th — 6–7–8 climb the G string as the shell moves up
F MAJOR · UP THE D STRING — 1·3·5·7 BOTTOM 4
roots on the D string: F·G·A·Bb·C·D·E at frets 3·5·7·8·10·12·14
root on the 4th string · 5th on G, 7th on B, 3rd on e — bottom 4 strings D·G·B·e
window keeps ascending (frets 12,14) — no wrap to open · ghost 6 rings the 7th on the B string (6 is the 7th of the chord one step below, no ghost 5 — the 5th is already a solid dot)
